cards.ex: Losing the contract was a bitter pill to swallow, but we'll learn from it.
cards.exUz: Shartnomani yo'qotish achchiq dori edi, lekin biz bundan saboq olamiz.
cards.uzDef: Qabul qilish yoki yutish qiyin bo'lgan narsa; yoqimsiz haqiqat.

cards.ex: He said he didn't want the promotion anyway, but it just sounds like sour grapes to me.
cards.exUz: U lavozimni xohlamasligini aytdi, lekin bu menga faqat nordon uzumdek tuyuladi.
cards.uzDef: Olish imkoni bo'lmagan narsani mensimaslik.

cards.ex: Don't try to sweet-talk me into doing your chores!
cards.exUz: Mening uy ishlarimni bajarishga shirin so'zlar bilan ko'ndirishga urinmang!
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir shirin so'zlar bilan ko'ndirishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: She has a nose for a good story; she always finds the best scoops.
cards.exUz: Uning yaxshi hikoyalar uchun sezgir burni bor; u har doim eng yaxshi yangiliklarni topadi.
cards.uzDef: Nimagadir tabiiy qobiliyat yoki instinktga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: I hope he'll come to his senses and apologize for what he said.
cards.exUz: U aqlga kelib, aytganlari uchun uzr so'rashiga umid qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri fikrlashdan to'xtash va to'g'ri qaror qabul qilish.

cards.ex: The new restaurant is a bit rough around the edges, but the food is amazing.
cards.exUz: Yangi restoran biroz qo'pol qirralarga ega, lekin taomlari ajoyib.
cards.uzDef: Mukammal emas, lekin asosiy jihatlari yaxshi.

cards.ex: I need to get a feel for the new software before I can use it properly.
cards.exUz: Men uni to'g'ri ishlatishimdan oldin yangi dasturiy ta'minotning hissini olishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Nima ekanligini tushunishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The surgery was touch and go for a while, but he's recovering now.
cards.exUz: Operatsiya bir muncha vaqt xavfli edi, lekin u hozir tuzalmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Natijasi aniq bo'lmagan vaziyat; xavfli.

cards.ex: The way they handled the situation left a bad taste in my mouth.
cards.exUz: Ular vaziyatni hal qilish usuli mening og'zimda yomon ta'm qoldirdi.
cards.uzDef: Yoqimsiz yoki norozi bo'lish hissi.

cards.ex: I smell a rat; I don't believe his story at all.
cards.exUz: Men kalxatni hidlayapman; Men uning hikoyasiga umuman ishonmayman.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri narsa bo'layotganiga shubhalanish.

cards.ex: Be careful what you say to her; she has a sharp tongue.
cards.exUz: Unga nima deyayotganingizga e'tibor bering; uning tili o'tkir.
cards.uzDef: Tanqidiy yoki sarkastik gapiradigan odam.

cards.ex: I have a soft spot for old movies; I love watching them.
cards.exUz: Menda eski filmlar uchun zaif nuqta bor; Men ularni tomosha qilishni yaxshi ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir yoki nimanidir juda yaxshi ko'rish.

cards.ex: I'll feel him out about the project to see if he's interested.
cards.exUz: Men uni loyiha haqida qiziqishini bilish uchun ehtiyotkorlik bilan yondashaman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani aniqlash uchun ehtiyotkorlik bilan yondashish.

cards.ex: He's always teasing people, so it's good he's getting a taste of his own medicine.
cards.exUz: U doimo odamlarni masxara qiladi, shuning uchun uning o'z dorisini tatib ko'rayotgani yaxshi.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir o'ziga yomon munosabatda bo'linishi.

cards.ex: I can't stomach his rude behavior; it's just awful.
cards.exUz: Men uning qo'pol xulqini hazm qila olmayman; bu shunchaki dahshatli.
cards.uzDef: Yoqtirmaslik yoki toqat qilolmaslik.

cards.ex: I have a gut feeling that something good is going to happen.
cards.exUz: Menda yaxshi narsa sodir bo'lishiga ichki his bor.
cards.uzDef: Intuisiya, isbotga asoslanmagan his.

cards.ex: I passed the exam by the skin of my teeth; I barely made it.
cards.exUz: Men imtihonni tirnoq uchida topshirdim; zo'rg'a o'tdim.
cards.term: by the skin of your teeth
cards.uzDef: Juda yaqin masofada, qiyinchilik bilan.

cards.ex: He deserves a pat on the back for all his hard work.
cards.exUz: U barcha mashaqqatli mehnati uchun yelkasiga qoqilishga loyiq.
cards.uzDef: Maqtov yoki rag'batlantirish.

cards.ex: I don't feel up to going out tonight; I'm too tired.
cards.exUz: Men bugun kechasi tashqariga chiqishga xohishim yo'q; men juda charchadim.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa qilishga energiya yoki xohishga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: My grandparents are the salt of the earth; they're always willing to help.
cards.exUz: Mening buvim va bobom yerning tuzi; ular har doim yordam berishga tayyor.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshi, halol va ishonchli odamlar.

cards.ex: He's a prickly character, so try not to upset him.
cards.exUz: U tikanli xarakter, shuning uchun uni xafa qilmaslikka harakat qiling.
cards.uzDef: Osongina g'azablanadigan yoki xafa bo'ladigan odam.

cards.ex: That's not a very palatable option, but we may have to consider it.
cards.exUz: Bu juda maqbul variant emas, lekin biz uni ko'rib chiqishimiz kerak bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Qabul qilishga yoki yoqtirishga arziydigan variant.

cards.ex: A glass of wine will take the edge off after a long day.
cards.exUz: Bir stakan vino uzoq kundan keyin keskinlikni yo'qotadi.
cards.uzDef: Nimaningdir kuchini kamaytirish, xususan, stress yoki og'riq.

cards.ex: That movie really left a mark on me; I can't stop thinking about it.
cards.exUz: Bu film menga haqiqatan ham iz qoldirdi; Men bu haqda o'ylashni to'xtata olmayman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga ta'sir ko'rsatish yoki esdalik qoldirish.

cards.ex: He has a dry sense of humor, so you might not realize he's joking.
cards.exUz: Uning quruq hazili bor, shuning uchun u hazillashayotganini sezmasligingiz mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Jiddiy ko'rinish bilan aytilgan hazil.

cards.ex: His arrogant attitude tends to rub people the wrong way.
cards.exUz: Uning takabbur munosabati odamlarni g'azablantirishga moyil.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir g'azablantirish yoki xafa qilish.

cards.ex: I got a whiff of something burning in the kitchen.
cards.exUz: Men oshxonada nimadir yonayotganining hidini oldim.
cards.uzDef: Qisqa vaqt ichida nimaningdir hidini sezish.

cards.ex: The singer has a velvety voice that is so soothing to listen to.
cards.exUz: Qo'shiqchining tinglash juda yoqimli bo'lgan baxmal ovozi bor.
cards.uzDef: Yoqimli va silliq ovoz.

cards.ex: When choosing fabrics for clothing, texture matters as much as color.
cards.exUz: Kiyim uchun matolarni tanlashda to'qima rang kabi muhim ahamiyatga ega.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning to'qilishi muhim rol o'ynaydi.

cards.ex: He's a smooth operator; he can talk anyone into anything.
cards.exUz: U ustasi farang; u har kimni har narsaga ko'ndira oladi.
cards.uzDef: O'z maqsadlariga erishish uchun odamlarni osonlikcha ishontira oladigan odam.
